title: Ensure build workers have minimal network connectivity
description: A build worker that can reach the whole network turns every malicious build into a pivot point. Worker network policy lives in firewalls, security groups and cluster policy — none of it visible to the controller.
remediation: Restrict each agent's egress to what builds actually need: the controller, the source host, the artifact store and approved package mirrors. Enforce it outside the worker — security groups, network policy, or a proxy — so a compromised build cannot lift the restriction.
fixSummary: Restrict agent egress with security groups to the controller, SCM and package mirrors.
